name: workspace-kit-theming-demo
description: Standalone, zero-Tailwind demo proving @mdly/workspace-kit's token-driven theming contract (docs/architecture/shared-markdown-editor-kit-plan.md Phase 2). Deliberately NOT an app/* or packages/* workspace member -- see pnpm-workspace.yaml at the repo root. Kept as a permanent fixture (not a throwaway) so future kit changes have a live tripwire if they silently break the "just override CSS variables" promise. Setup: run `pnpm install` at the repo root first (so packages/workspace-kit and its dependencies are resolved), then `npm run build` here -- it runs link-deps.mjs (symlinks this demo's node_modules straight to the monorepo's already-resolved copies of every dependency listed below, guaranteeing identical versions to what the kit itself was built and tested against, with no independent npm/pnpm resolution step and no network access) before bundling with esbuild.
